My best estimate is that J&J's gross profit rose about 1.5% from fiscal Q1 2024 to fiscal Q4 2024. This rests partly on figures I recalled from memory and could not check against the filings.

- **Q1 2024:** sales of about $21,383M less cost of products sold of about $6,709M gives gross profit of about $14,674M.
- **Q4 2024:** sales of about $22,520M. I could not recall the Q4 cost of products sold reliably, so I assumed Q4 gross profit of roughly $14.9 billion.

The Q4 gross profit is the weak link, so the percentage is an approximation.
